workflows.success: Freeze a candidate schedule and source revision; stage against confirmed predecessor and adopt only exact current proposer, both locations, future timing, capacity and no scans. Original stays authoritative until replacement accepted.

workflows.success: Event cancellation/change drives attributed per-registration notices/refund and venue cleanup; latest event revision suppresses explicitly obsolete authored notices.
